name: Soybean meal; regional mix; NOPA processing; at farm
description: Approximation for the contribution of soybean meal from the five USDA feed production regions, which are aggregated to represent the commodity market for soybean meal fed to swine in the US.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This unit process represents production in the US
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This process produces soybean meal feed; at farm.  This process includes soybean meal production unit processes from the five USDA feed production regions, which are aggregated to represent soybean meal feed production in the US.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Upstream unit processes for the five USDA soybean meal production regions are aggregated to represent the regionally produced feed mix for the US commodity market for swine feed.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: This is a unit process for U.S. regions with model beeing fixed to give result for Region #5 which we assumed to model Illinois state. Background unit processes include domestic soymeal production (96% of total), which was modeled as the U.S. weighted average of production regions. Imported soybean meal (4%) was Agri-footprint database unit process "Soybean meal, from crushing (solvent), at plant/BR Economic"
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Flow values within this dataset were obtained from a variety of sources, including the 2007 NASS Census of Agriculture and process model simulations of the pig production process (see supporting documentation).
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data for this project was collected from 2007 to 2014. Unit process data were compiled in 2014.

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.

publication.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios
